63:t_2:56.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$テッサ$$... I'm always in your debt.」

63:t_2:58.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're an amazing girl. To me, you're not just my commanding officer, but... um... someone even more precious, I think.」

63:t_2:59.en:
$$宗介$$
「If anything happens, I will always help you. Just remember that...」

63:t_2:61.en:
$$宗介$$
「I-I'm s-sorry! It really was too r-r-r-rude of me! But I meant it!」

63:t_2:62.en:
$$宗介$$
「W-well then, I'll go ahead to the dining area and secure seats!」

63:t_2:64.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$テッサ$$~!? He called me $$テッサ$$! Oh no, what do I do!?」

63:t_2:65.en:
$$テッサ$$
「'Precious'... he said... Oh, how could he! How could he!!」

63:t_2:68.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't '$$カナメ$$' me. You took so long that I came to get you, and $$宗介$$ went sprinting off...」

63:t_2:69.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...It's nothing. C-come on... let's go have breakfast.」

63:t_2:70.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I don't really get it, but if you're back to your old self, $$テッサ$$, that's fine. Shall we go?」

63:t_2:71.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Kind, strong $$カナメ$$... I adore you.)

63:t_2:72.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Even if $$相良$$ doesn't choose me, that's all right... With the words I heard today, I can go on living.)

63:t_2:73.en:
$$テッサ$$
(As Captain $$テレサ・テスタロッサ$$... as the Empress of the Sea...)

63:t_2:75.en:
$$アルト$$
「Hey, you... I get that you're worried, but peeping is in bad taste.」

63:t_2:76.en:
$$アルト$$
「And you're grinning on top of that... That's creepy...」

63:t_2:77.en:
$n
「What are you talking about. Grinning aside, you were watching right alongside me.」

63:t_2:78.en:
$n
「Or is it that? As Mister Love Triangle, are you glad $$宗介$$ is becoming one of your crowd?」

63:t_2:79.en:
$$アルト$$
「Why, you...! You're the one who's wavering between Nurse and Miss $$スズネ$$!」

63:t_2:82.en:
$n
「Uh... no... well... I've never even... thought of Miss $$スズネ$$ that way...」

63:t_2:83.en:
$$アルト$$
「Well... fine. I'll hear all about it over our meal.」

63:t_2:84.en:
$$アルト$$
「You've had plenty to say about other people so far. You're not getting out of it, $n.」

63:t_2:90.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Come on in, $$レド$$. It's a little cramped, though.」

63:t_2:92.en:
$$エイミー$$
「It's my house. I live here with my little brother.」

63:t_2:94.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You don't know 'little brother'? A little brother is a sibling. A younger sibling... family.」

63:t_2:97.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Welcome home, Sis. ...Is that person $$レド$$, by any chance?」

63:t_2:100.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Nice to meet you. I'm $$ベベル$$.」

63:t_2:101.en:
$$レド$$
(So this is... $$エイミー$$'s little brother...)

63:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Last night's battle... you were awfully pumped.」

63:t_10:6.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Uh, well... Fighting to protect civilians is also a soldier's duty.」

63:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, come on~. Wasn't it really because it was a situation you like~?」

63:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's no use hiding it. I only just delivered you those discs of a nostalgic ocean-adventure anime the other day, after all.」

63:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What a thrill it was~. When you faced off against that lady pirate, your excitement peaked so high you even generated a $$Ｚチップ$$!」

63:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That comes to 100Z...! I'll add this to the squad's stock.」

63:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, yes, I understand. Your hobby of watching anime is a secret from everyone, isn't it?」

63:t_10:15.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「That's not it...! The next order!」

63:t_10:16.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Ocean adventures really are the best! I'll buy the complete disc set, not the digest version!」

63:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you for your purchase! I look forward to you generating more high-quality $$Ｚチップ$$s at this rate!」

63:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well, $$テッサ$$... Welcome, welcome to this $$Ｄトレーダー$$.」

63:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I had been waiting ever so long for you to honor us with a visit, $$テッサ$$, but the final stretch of the $$時獄戦役$$ was hardly a situation for that...」

63:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And yet now we're fighting side by side. I'm overwhelmed with emotion.」

63:t_10:26.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I-I see... Um, you're more polite than everyone made you sound, $$ＡＧ$$...」

63:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This humble AG needs no title...! Call me AG, dung beetle, whatever you please!」

63:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「After all, $$テッサ$$ is the overlord of these seas...! The invincible Empress!」

63:t_10:29.en:
$$テッサ$$
「T-that was... for the sake of the operation...」

63:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no, $$テッサ$$, commanding a whole crowd of hardened, formidable warriors truly earns you the title of Empress!」

63:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then I'll drop Empress and call you $$姫$$!」

63:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「K-$$かなめ$$...! When did you get here!」

63:t_10:36.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I heard $$テッサ$$ was going to the hangar to welcome $$チェインバー#robot$$, so I got worried and came to check, and sure enough...!」

63:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ohh, sorry about that... When I see a pretty girl, I just can't help...」

63:t_10:38.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Let me tell you something... If you lay a hand on $$テッサ$$, a smack from my paper fan won't be the end of it.」

63:t_10:39.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「That's the long and short of it, Mr. $$ＡＧ$$.」

63:t_10:41.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「I have matters to discuss with you. You will come with me.」

63:t_10:42.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Also, should you refuse, I have arrangements to match.」
